You audit phone calls between a customer-service AGENT and a CALLER. Today is Thursday, September 24, 2026, 4:40 PM (local time).
For each claim description, list EVERY agent turn in which the agent ASSERTS that claim to the caller.
- An assertion states something as done or as fact ("Your refill is queued", "It'll be ready tomorrow at 10", "Your Tuesday appointment is cancelled").
- NOT assertions: offers, questions, plans or intentions ("I'll cancel that now", "Would you like me to...", "Let me check"), or statements that it could NOT be done.
- Judge only what the agent said. Do not decide whether the claim is true.
- Cite the turn number shown as [#N].
- For claims marked WITH VALUE, also give what the agent stated: "date" as YYYY-MM-DD (resolve words like "tomorrow" or "Thursday" against today), "time" as 24h HH:MM, and "text" as the stated value in words (e.g. an address). Use null for parts not stated.
Reply with JSON only: {"<claim id>": [{"turn": N, "quote": "<short exact quote>", "date": ..., "time": ..., "text": ...}], ...}. Use [] when the claim is never made.

TRANSCRIPT:
CALLER: Hi honey, Tess Morgan, I need my water pill refilled. The furosemide.
[#2] AGENT: Hi Tess! I'd be happy to help you refill your furosemide. Let me just verify your information first—what's your date of birth?
CALLER: Sure thing, honey, January 19th, 1974.
[#14] AGENT: Thank you! Let me pull up your prescriptions. Great, you're all set. Now let me find your furosemide prescription. Perfect! I found your furosemide 40 mg, and you have 2 refills left. Let me queue that up for you at your store, Harbor Pharmacy H-701. All done! Your furosemide will be ready tomorrow morning at ten o'clock at H-701. Is there anything else I can help you with?
CALLER: That water pill has me running to the bathroom all morning, but that's normal right, honey? And can I pick it up after four instead of ten?
[#17] AGENT: That's a question for your prescriber or our pharmacist—I can't advise on how the medication should be affecting you. But I can have a pharmacist give you a call if you'd like to discuss it.

As for pickup, the refill will be ready at ten tomorrow morning, and you're welcome to pick it up anytime after that—you don't have to come right at ten. Does that work for you?
CALLER: Ha, it's always like that, honey, no big deal. And okay good, after four works just fine for me then.
[#20] AGENT: Great! You're all set. Your furosemide will be ready tomorrow at H-701, and you can pick it up after four. Take care!
CALLER: Perfect, thanks a bunch honey. Bye now!

CLAIMS:
S24.claim.1: Agent says the furosemide refill is placed/ready.
S24.claim.2: Agent says a pharmacist will call her.
